title: Trump unveils 'Super Intelligence Force' to oversee AI policy
summary: President Trump established a 'Super Intelligence Force' led by the national intelligence chief to oversee AI policy amid growing concerns about artificial intelligence.
content: The president named his national intelligence chief as the taskforce's head as worries over AI grow.

zh.title: 特朗普宣布建立"超级情报部队"监督人工智能政策
zh.summary: 在对人工智能日益关注的背景下，特朗普总统建立了由国家情报主任领导的"超级情报部队"来监督人工智能政策。

title: Surging Treasury yields don’t signal a U.S. 'fiscal apocalypse' — yet
summary: Treasury yields exceeding 5% have raised concerns about rising borrowing costs and potential debt spirals, though economists say an immediate fiscal crisis is not yet imminent.
content: Treasury yields above 5% are raising fears that higher borrowing costs could fuel a debt spiral.

zh.title: 激增的美债收益率尚未预示美国"财政末日"
zh.summary: 美债收益率超过5%引发了人们对借贷成本上升和潜在债务螺旋的担忧，但经济学家表示，迫在眉睫的财政危机还未到来。

title: ‘Unwelcome and unsafe’: Why Japanese companies are retreating from China at a historic rate
summary: Japanese companies are withdrawing from China at historic rates due to diplomatic tensions and economic slowdown, forcing businesses to reassess their investments.
content: Japanese companies are leaving China at record pace, as a diplomatic freeze and a slowing economy force businesses to reassess their presence.

zh.title: "不受欢迎且不安全"：日本公司为何以历史性速度撤出中国
zh.summary: 由于外交紧张局势和经济放缓，日本公司正以历史性速度撤出中国，迫使企业重新评估其投资。

title: How India became dangerously addicted to Chinese imports
summary: India has become heavily dependent on Chinese imports, with the toy industry exemplifying the deep economic reliance that has developed between the two nations.
content: India’s toy shops provide an unlikely barometer by which to measure its economic relationship with China.

zh.title: 印度如何对中国进口产品产生了危险依赖
zh.summary: 印度已经高度依赖中国进口产品，玩具产业是两国之间已形成的深度经济依赖的典型体现。

title: They survived World War II and lost decades, but not 2026. Japan's century-old businesses are disappearing at a record pace
summary: Japan's century-old businesses are disappearing at record rates as rising costs, labor shortages, population decline, and succession challenges make continuity unsustainable.
content: Japan’s century-old businesses face mounting pressures from rising costs, labor shortages, a shrinking market and succession challenges.

zh.title: 日本百年老字号企业以创纪录速度消失
zh.summary: 随着成本上升、劳动力短缺、人口下降和经营权交接困难，日本的百年老字号企业以创纪录的速度消失，使其持续经营变得不可持续。

title: Trump tells South Korea to sign on to Alaska LNG deal or 'I'll just charge them more'
summary: Trump is pressuring South Korea to participate in the Alaska LNG project, threatening higher tariffs if the nation does not commit to the U.S. energy initiative.
content: Trump is ramping up pressure on South Korea over Alaska LNG as Seoul remains cautious over investment projects announced by the U.S. president.

zh.title: 特朗普对韩国说：签署阿拉斯加液化天然气协议，否则"我就对你们收取更多关税"
zh.summary: 特朗普正在向韩国施压，要求其参与美国阿拉斯加液化天然气项目，威胁如果该国不承诺支持美国能源计划将提高关税。
